question: Will nationwide voting for the 26th Knesset take place on October 27, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if nationwide election-day voting for the 26th Knesset takes place on October 27, 2026, per the Central Elections Committee or a consensus of credible reporting. Disruption in a few localities still counts as yes. No if voting is moved to another date.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes. Our last number was 95.5%. Brier 0.002. Election held Oct 27 as scheduled; results certified Nov 4. Official CEC results certified 2026-11-04 (israelvote.meforum.org, israelnationalnews.com/news/435272): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Together 12, Joint List 11, Democrats 8, Raam 8, Yisrael Beytenu 7 (5.93%), Otzma 7, UTJ 7, Shas 6, RZ-Zehut 6; Netanyahu bloc 53, opposition 48, Arab parties 19; Amcha Yisrael 1.68%, below the threshold.

annulled_reason: Withdrawn 10/19/2026: priced near certain (95%), so scoring it says almost nothing about forecasting skill. Replaced by fc-il-amcha-yisrael-passes-threshold.
